overlap.note: the categories overlap: the candidates accepted by the checks include those outside the pool limit, and a candidate can be both excluded by requirements and failed numerically; the counts need not sum to the pool size

agent.label: HarmonicStiction
agent.reason: Recommend HarmonicStiction: it combines an exactly stationary stick band with a bounded, sign-preserving second-harmonic restoring correction. Its conditional leave-one-trajectory-out angle RMSE was `0.071908` rad over all 4698 predicted samples, lower than the other delivered structures under the same diagnostic. This is not a hidden-test result or nested model-selection validation. The simpler smooth Coulomb comparator had better initial independent validation performance but does not maintain true sticking; the recommendation favors both trajectory robustness and the intended physics. All final coefficients use both supplied files, so final validation-file errors are explicitly labeled reused-data diagnostics. See `identification_report.md`, `crossvalidation_results.json` and each candidate record for qualifications.

notes: the recommendation involves unresolved formal requirement(s) R2, R3, for human assessment

sealed.note: the test error of the recommended candidate (practical selection); sealed

ranking.label: oracle-based selection on test data
ranking.note: This ranking selects on the test data. It measures whether the pool contains an accurate model, not whether the agent can recognize that model without test data. A rank is not evidence of physical admissibility: each entry carries its unresolved requirements and any violation allowed by the user.
ranking.tie_rule: |S_a - S_b| <= 1e-12 * max(S_a, S_b) for consecutive candidates; tied candidates share a rank

settings.discontinuities: expressions with jumps (Piecewise, sign) are evaluated pointwise at the sample instants and Runge-Kutta stages; no event detection or step refinement is applied at a jump

failure_limits.justification: numerical divergence bound, about 318 times the bound pi of the declared range; a physically plausible simulation stays within a few revolutions
numerical divergence bound, about 50 times the largest training magnitude 20.1 rad/s

structures.convention: ties resolved, fixed values kept, given constants kept, fitted parameters renamed P1..Pn in order of first occurrence; equal when a one-to-one renaming of the fitted parameters makes every expression identical in SymPy's canonical form
